title: I am Pratap
scope: Pronouns, the verb “to be”, yes/no questions, noun plurals, adjective agreement

gloss.क्या: marks a yes/no question, so no English word lines up with it
gloss.जी: adds respect and is not translated

lessons.title: हूँ, हो, है or हैं?
lessons.desc: Pick the right form of “to be”

wrong: हो
हो goes only with तुम (familiar “you”). मैं always takes हूँ.
है
है goes with one person or thing: यह, वह, तू or a singular noun. मैं always takes हूँ.
हैं goes with हम, आप, ये, वे, plural nouns, and anyone spoken of with respect. मैं always takes हूँ.
हूँ goes only with मैं (I). तुम takes हो.
है
है goes with one person or thing: यह, वह, तू or a singular noun. तुम takes हो.
हैं goes with हम, आप, ये, वे, plural nouns, and anyone spoken of with respect. तुम takes हो.

lessons.title: Usage and word order
lessons.desc: Honorifics, questions, what a sentence means

items.q: You meet a friend's grandmother for the first time. Which “you” do you use?
wrong: तुम
आप is the respectful default. तुम is for friends and people who expect no formality; तू is only for intimates and small children.
तू
आप is the respectful default. तुम is for friends and people who expect no formality; तू is only for intimates and small children.

items.q: Which pronoun takes the verb form हो?
wrong: आप
Only तुम takes हो. आप takes हैं, मैं takes हूँ, वह takes है.
Only तुम takes हो. आप takes हैं, मैं takes हूँ, वह takes है.
वह
Only तुम takes हो. आप takes हैं, मैं takes हूँ, वह takes है.

items.q: तू is safe to use with…
items.a: a small child or someone very close
wrong: a shopkeeper
तू marks great intimacy. With anyone else it sounds disrespectful.
your teacher

a new colleague

items.q: Your teacher is standing beside you. How do you say “He is Indian” respectfully?
wrong: यह हिन्दुस्तानी है
For someone you would call आप, use the plural pronoun and verb: ये for someone near, वे for someone further away.
वह हिन्दुस्तानी है
For someone you would call आप, use the plural pronoun and verb: ये for someone near, वे for someone further away.
तुम हिन्दुस्तानी हो
For someone you would call आप, use the plural pronoun and verb: ये for someone near, वे for someone further away.
Male versus female
यह points to something nearby, वह to something further off. Neither shows gender.
Polite versus casual
यह points to something nearby, वह to something further off. Neither shows gender.
One versus many
यह points to something nearby, वह to something further off. Neither shows gender.
This is a red car.
The adjective comes after the noun, so “red” is what is being said about the car.

The adjective comes after the noun, so “red” is what is being said about the car.

The adjective comes before the noun, so the two belong together: “a red car”.

The adjective comes before the noun, so the two belong together: “a red car”.

The adjective comes before the noun, so the two belong together: “a red car”.

items.q: How do you turn तुम ठीक हो into a yes/no question?
wrong: Change हो to हैं
क्या at the start marks a yes/no question. Nothing else in the sentence changes.
Swap the first two words
क्या at the start marks a yes/no question. Nothing else in the sentence changes.
Add नहीं before हो
क्या at the start marks a yes/no question. Nothing else in the sentence changes.
At the very start
The order is subject first, verb last, with नहीं just before the verb.
After the verb
The order is subject first, verb last, with नहीं just before the verb.
Before the subject
The order is subject first, verb last, with नहीं just before the verb.

Feminine nouns ending in a consonant add -ẽ.

किताबियाँ

नहीं negates what comes before it here. The first हूँ has been dropped, which is allowed after नहीं.
